33.name: AGND
33.hint: AGND: ground reference of GPIO26–29 with its own analog ground plane; may join digital ground when ADC performance is not critical

34.name: GP28_ADC2

35.name: ADC_VREF
35.hint: ADC supply and reference, the 3.3 V rail filtered by 201 Ω into 2.2 µF; may take an external reference (e.g. a 3.0 V shunt)

36.name: 3V3(OUT)
36.hint: 3.3 V of the on-board buck-boost SMPS; keep the external load below 300 mA

37.name: 3V3_EN
37.hint: SMPS enable, pulled up to VSYS with 100 kΩ; short low to switch the 3.3 V (and the MCU) off

39.name: VSYS
39.hint: main input 1.8–5.5 V to the buck-boost SMPS; fed from VBUS through a Schottky diode on the board

40.name: VBUS
40.hint: the micro-USB 5 V (5 V ± 10 %), 0 V without USB; in USB host mode the board must be fed with 5 V here

41.name: SWCLK
41.hint: SWD clock, debug pad D1 next to pin 20

43.name: SWDIO
43.hint: SWD data, debug pad D3 next to pin 21

TP4.name: GPIO23/SMPS PS
TP4.hint: GPIO23 drives the SMPS power-save pin – do not use

TP5.name: GPIO25/LED
TP5.hint: GPIO25 drives the user LED – swings only to the LED's forward voltage, not recommended

TP6.name: BOOTSEL
TP6.hint: short low at power-up: USB mass-storage programming mode

compliance.source: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 Datasheet, release 5 (build 03/07/2026, d4e0f1799616), RP-008299-DS-3: RP2350 with flash, crystal, buck-boost SMPS and micro-USB (1, 4.4) – no radio on the board (the wireless variant is the Pico W / Pico 2 W) – read 2026-10-31

sources: pin names: from the Pico 2 datasheet (figure 2 pinout, 3.1) as in the example project's entry (tests/fixtures/led-bar) – the EasyEDA symbol of C41407547 names pins 2–6 TP2–TP6 instead of GP1, GND, GP2, GP3, GP4 and pin 41 SWDIO, 43 SWCLK, against the datasheet (figure 2: SWCLK next to pin 20, SWDIO next to pin 21) and the footprint (pad 41 next to pad 20)
footprint, mpn, jlc_class: EasyEDA library data of C41407547 (edakit part import, 2026-10-31); footprint pads 1–43 and TP1–TP6 (pad 41 at the debug end next to pad 20)

Raspberry Pi Pico 2 Datasheet, release 5 (build 03/07/2026, d4e0f1799616), RP-008299-DS-3 (datasheets.raspberrypi.com, read 2026-10-31): figure 2 pinout, figure 4 pin numbering (debug pads D1–D3), 'pinout' section (VSYS 1.8–5.5 V, 3V3_EN 100 kΩ to VSYS, 3V3 load < 300 mA, RUN ~50 kΩ on-chip pull-up, AGND, ADC_VREF, TP1–TP6), recommended operating conditions (–20 … 85 °C incl. self-heating, 70 °C ambient, VBUS 5 V ± 10 %, VSYS 1.8–5.5 V), General purpose I/O (GPIO26–29: IOVDD + about 300 mV), ADC (201 Ω / 2.2 µF), Powerchain (RT6150 buck-boost, fixed 3.3 V)

RP2350 Datasheet, release 8 (build 01/10/2026, 80d627281ed5), RP-008373-DS-3 (read 2026-10-31): VPIN_FT abs. max 5.5 V with IOVDD at 3.3 V, 3.63 V with IOVDD at 1.8 V or 0 V; standard IO IOVDD + 0.5 V (table 1680); VIH min 2 V and VIL max 0.8 V at IOVDD 3.3 V (table 1683); VOH/VOL at IOH/IOL 2, 4, 8 or 12 mA by drive setting; RPU 32–86 kΩ, RPD 36–113 kΩ at IOVDD 3.3 V (table 1683); IIOVDD_MAX 100 mA sourced, IIOVSS_MAX 100 mA sunk (table 1683)

pin functions: pico-sdk 2.1.1, src/rp2350/hardware_regs/include/hardware/regs/io_bank0.h (IO_BANK0_GPIOn_CTRL_FUNCSEL_VALUE_* of GPIO0–28: SPI, UART, I2C, PWM), platform_defs.h (ADC_BASE_PIN 26), boards/pico2.h (PICO_SMPS_MODE_PIN 23, PICO_DEFAULT_LED_PIN 25) – raw.githubusercontent.com/raspberrypi/pico-sdk/2.1.1, read 2026-10-31
GPIO v_max_v 3.63 V: the level the FT pins tolerate with IOVDD at 0 V – the lower bound of the chip's limits; GPIO26–28 3.6 V: IOVDD + about 300 mV of the board datasheet
gpio_i_max_a 0.012 A: the highest drive setting at which VOH/VOL are specified – assumption: the datasheet gives no absolute maximum per pin
regulator 'buck': the on-board RT6150 is a buck-boost (the schema knows ldo, buck, boost) – the simulation models it as a buck with the default efficiency
t_max_c 70 °C: the recommended maximum ambient (85 °C including self-heating)
3V3_EN v_max_v 5.5 V: it is pulled up to VSYS (at most 5.5 V) on the board – the SMPS's own EN rating was not read
USB DM/DP (TP2/TP3) v_max_v 3.63 V: below the standard-IO limit IOVDD + 0.5 V – conservative
notes: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 (RP2350) as a module, reflow-soldered on its castellated pads or plugged on headers. Behaviour model 'mcu' with the on-board buck-boost (VSYS → 3V3).

checked: pin allocation 1–40 and the debug pads (SWCLK next to pin 20, GND, SWDIO next to pin 21) against figures 2 and 4
VSYS 1.8–5.5 V; VBUS 5 V ± 10 %; 3V3 load < 300 mA; 3V3_EN 100 kΩ to VSYS; RUN ~50 kΩ pull-up
GPIO26–28: IOVDD + about 300 mV, leak when unpowered
RP2350: VIH 2 V / VIL 0.8 V at 3.3 V, total IO current 100 mA sourced and sunk, abs. max pin voltage
functions of GPIO0–28 from the FUNCSEL values of io_bank0.h; PWM slice (n >> 1) & 7, channel a/b
open: core current (i_core_a): the datasheet gives only typical VBUS currents of example programs, no maximum – the simulation's default applies
SMPS efficiency: no figure read – the simulation's default 0.85 applies; buck-boost not in the regulator enum (schema gap)
gpio_i_max_a is the highest specified drive setting, not an absolute maximum
gpio_r_out_ohm: not given (VOL 0.5 V at the drive setting's current only)
RoHS/REACH: not stated in the board datasheet
SWCLK/SWDIO pull: on-chip pull-up at reset (chip pin table), resistance not given separately
TP7 (1V1, do not use) of the Pico 2 is not a pad of the SC0916 footprint
